label: 四足跪姿 / 臀部后抬
pose_lead: Grounded pose, quadruped kneel with the hips raised:
lower_limbs: Both knees rest on the ground fairly close together, the lower legs flat behind, the seat held higher than the shoulders.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach forward and down, hands planted on the ground.
torso_head: The lower back curves into a clear arch, the abdomen lightly drawn in; the head turns to one side.
weight_silhouette: Weight distributes between the knees and the palms; the whole figure reads as a front-low, rear-high ramp.
